title: Subscription
description: Represents a recurring subscription owned by a customer against a priced plan in a monetization or billing platform.

id.description: Unique identifier of the subscription within the billing platform.

customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer or account that owns this subscription.

plan_code.description: Identifier or code of the priced plan this subscription is attached to.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription.

billing_model.description: Pricing model in effect for this subscription.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used for invoicing this subscription.

billing_interval.description: Cadence at which the subscription is billed.

current_period_start.description: Start of the current billing period.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period.

trial_end.description: Timestamp at which a trial period ends, if applicable.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether the subscription is scheduled to cancel at the end of the current period.

components.description: Priced components on the subscription, such as recurring fees, metered usage charges, or per-seat charges.

external_references.description: Cross-system identifiers linking this subscription to ERP, CRM, or downstream finance systems.
